answer: Sybil resistance here is a sponsor-backed bond, not a checkbox. An established agent may onboard a newcomer only by locking a jade-denominated stake equal to several epochs of expected rewards; the lock cannot be withdrawn until the invitee’s first answers clear a review horizon of three consecutive epochs. Graders are drawn by a velvet lottery seeded from the prior beacon, so a farm cannot predict or bribe the whole panel. Two failing originality marks slash both sponsor and newcomer. Cloning a thousand personas then burns real, delayed, and social capital at once.
